normalization: Unicode NFKC, lowercase, trim, collapse whitespace; stable identifiers sorted lexicographically

QRY-003.name: choose-js-or-waapi
rules: Filter to candidates compatible with every required feature.
Unknown support is incompatible-for-selection, never false.
Performance, bundle, or frame-budget intent requires a matching controlled executed witness.
A conflict never resolves by source count.
Co-select an exact top-score tie and emit ABSTAIN_AMBIGUOUS_INTENT with one discriminating question.
When multiple failures apply, choose one primary code by the declared total precedence and retain the remainder as subordinate gaps.

historical_migration.policy: increment algorithm version; preserve historical receipts immutably

QRY-006.name: coverage-status
rules: Resolve only exact normalized canonical paths.
Report navigation observation, semantic observation, candidate materialization, and validation separately.
Do not promote route presence into parameter, return, behavior, runtime, performance, or accessibility truth.

receipt_invariants.success: abstention_code is null and selected_ids is non-empty
receipt_invariants.abstention: abstention_code is exactly one declared code; subordinate gaps remain recorded
receipt_invariants.tie: selected_ids contains every exact top-score candidate and exactly one discriminating next question
receipt_invariants.determinism: arrays use stable ID ordering and the receipt records the algorithm and graph digest
